candidates.description: This feature vector activates on names of historical, regional, or colonial cities and towns predominantly found in North America and the British Isles.
This vector represents adverbial suffixes, nominalizations, and stem variations related to manner, state, and degree across Romance languages like Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, and French.
This feature vector represents names of states located in the United States.
This feature vector represents adjectives and adverbs emphasizing significance, scale, or distinct attributes.
These tokens represent common Spanish action verbs in their infinitive or root forms.
This vector represents common Spanish verbal roots and lemmas, particularly related to actions and events.
This feature vector represents concepts related to conflict, dispute, and significant impactful events.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Spanish and Latin root "qu-" and its common morphological variations.
This vector activates on words and word fragments starting with the letters "po", "pa", or "co".
This vector represents Latin-derived root words or prefixes associated with continuation, completion, and electricity across multiple languages.
